Workload

The distributed ocean run writes full history fields and restart files at the checkpoint and final steps.

Correctness

NetCDF variables, dimensions and fields must match the reference. The unmodified ocean model must resume from the checkpoint and recover the prescribed final state.

Timing

The timer covers the initial ocean simulation. Restart runs and output comparisons follow separately.
